purpose: Test the evidence-selected mount-plus-PID namespace control-plane ablation against the finalized stock-namespace B6-T and mount-only B3 baselines under the fixed Toybox probe, then prove independent stock recovery.

classification.basis: Management checks passed, Linux /init and VSOCK initialized, the registered Toybox VHDX mounted read-write, CreateInstanceResult succeeded, and the exact Toybox smoke command printed toybox-ok with exit zero. The mount-only sibling failed after B3, while restoring PID namespace semantics recovered B6-T without IPC or UTS namespaces.

traceAnalysis.directEvidence: The registered ext4 distro mounted, CreateInstanceEnd returned success, the exact Toybox smoke process passed, and termination was graceful with no GuestLog fatal signature.

comparison.selectedNamespacePolicy: Retain mount and PID namespace semantics. IPC and UTS namespace semantics are not required by the tested minimal WSL contract; PID semantics are selected by the controlled mount-only failure and mount-plus-PID restored success.

decision: Finalize minimal-v5-mount-pid-ns at B6-T. Retain mount plus PID semantics, reject IPC and UTS from the minimal control plane, and promote CONFIG_PID_NS as a WSL control requirement before the next reduced-kernel runtime candidate.
